title: NecroCore
description: Transform your hardcore experience with a second chance system - concussion mechanics instead of instant death!

# NecroCore: Advanced Hardcore Revival System
Transform instant death into strategic gameplay with NecroCore's comprehensive revival mechanics. This plugin replaces traditional hardcore death with concussion states, ghost modes, and ritual-based resurrection, creating intense team dynamics and meaningful consequences.

_The link to support the project is in the same place as the link to the source code_

## ✨ Core Features
🆘 Concussion & Rescue System
When players take fatal damage, they enter a 5-minute concussion state instead of dying instantly. Teammates can rescue them using:

Golden Apple → 20% health recovery

Enchanted Golden Apple → 50% health recovery + permanent +1 heart max health (if below 10 hearts)

Totem of Undying → Full heal (minimum 20 HP)

## 👻 Intelligent Ghost Mode
Players who aren't rescued become ghosts with special abilities:

Invisibility and night vision

Flight capabilities

Instant healing and saturation effects

Cannot interact with the world (blocks, entities, items)

Switch between ghost and spectator modes with /necromode

## ⚗️ Ritual Revival System
Ghosts can be properly resurrected through dangerous totem rituals:

Requirements: Reviver must hold totems in both hands with at least 4 hearts of health

Progressive Difficulty: Revival failure chance starts at 70% and decreases with successful attempts between same players (minimum 10%)

Consequences: Failed revivals spawn zombie versions of the target

Health Exchange: Reviver loses 2 hearts max HP, resurrected gains 1 heart max HP

## ⚡ Admin & Utility Features
Force Revival: /necroforce <player|all> for emergency situations

Quick Transition: /ghostnow to skip concussion timer

Manual Ghost Toggle: /gamemode ghost (with permission)

Configurable Death Modes: Choose between ghost or spectator afterlife

## 🛠️ Commands & Permissions
### Player Commands
Command	Description	Permission
- /necro <player>	Start revival ritual	necrocore.revive
- /necro accept	Accept revival request	necrocore.accept
- /necromode <ghost/spectator>	Set preferred death mode	necrocore.mode
- /ghostnow	Skip concussion to ghost mode	necrocore.ghostnow
### Admin Commands
Command	Description	Permission
- /necroforce <player>	Force revive specific player	necrocore.force
- /necroforce all	Mass revive all dead players	necrocore.force
- /gamemode ghost	Toggle ghost mode manually	necrocore.ghost.gamemode
- New Command: /necrohealth [page] – Shows a list of online players with their current max health (paginated).
- New Command: /necroghosts [page] – Lists all ghosts (online & offline) with death coordinates, world, and time of death.
### Permission Nodes
necrocore.* - All permissions

necrocore.revive - Create revival requests

necrocore.accept - Accept revival requests

necrocore.mode - Change death mode

necrocore.force - Force revival (admin)

necrocore.ghostnow - Use /ghostnow command

necrocore.ghost.gamemode - Use /gamemode ghost

## 📦 Installation
Download the latest NecroCore.jar from the files section

Place it in your server's plugins folder

Restart your server

Configure permissions using your preferred permissions plugin

Players automatically receive appropriate permissions based on plugin.yml defaults

## ❓ FAQ

**Q**: Can I configure the concussion timer?
**A**: Currently fixed at 5 minutes, but configurable versions may be released based on demand.

**Q**: What happens if a server restarts during concussion?
**A**: The concussion timer persists through restarts. Players re-join in the same state.

**Q**: How does the max health increase from enchanted apples work?
**A**: Only works if player has less than 10 hearts (20 HP). Adds +1 heart permanently, capping at 10 hearts.

## 📊 Why Choose NecroCore?
### ✅ Traditional Hardcore
- Instant permanent death
- No second chances
- Eliminated players can only spectate
- Minimal team interaction during death events

### ✅ NecroCore Enhanced Hardcore
- Strategic 5-minute rescue windows
- Multiple revival methods with different costs
- Ghost mode with gameplay purpose
- Progressive difficulty in revivals
- Team coordination requirements
- Meaningful risk/reward decisions
